messages:
olivia_acme: Hi team — we just noticed an unexpected RBAC grant in our Private tenant (tenant-id: tenant-78b). svc-redwood-bridge was bound to 'tenant-admin' around 2026-03-18. Can you confirm source and whether any KMS decrypts happened?

sara-support: hey @olivia_acme — sorry to hear that. Can you paste the exact role-binding (obfuscated is fine) and the approximate time? we'll triage.

olivia_acme: snippet: ```roleBinding: name: bridge-admin subject: svc-redwood-bridge role: tenant-admin createdAt: 2026-03-18T14:11:23Z``` saw it in tenant audit stream at ~14:12. No other anomalous traffic seen yet.

miguel-infra: pinging @raj-security. Quick check: can you run audit search for that principal? locally you can run: ```redwoodctl audit search --tenant tenant-78b --principal svc-redwood-bridge --since 72h --type role_binding``` That pulls the who/what.

audit-bot: result: role_binding.create by principal infra-automation@partner (system-token) at 2026-03-18T14:11:23Z, via API endpoint /v1/iam/bindings. No subsequent privileged API calls from svc-redwood-bridge in the 72h window.

raj-security: containment steps: 1) remove the binding immediately: ```redwoodctl iam revoke-binding --tenant tenant-78b --subject svc-redwood-bridge --role tenant-admin``` 2) rotate any service account tokens tied to svc-redwood-bridge, 3) check KMS decrypts: ```redwoodctl kms decrypt-logs --tenant tenant-78b --principal svc-redwood-bridge --since 7d``` 4) snapshot audit logs and hand to security for retention.

olivia_acme: running step 3 now — will paste results. Also I've revoked the binding and rotated the token per step 1/2.

audit-bot: kms.decrypt event search: zero decrypt events for svc-redwood-bridge in the last 7d. Only decrypts found are from app-prod service accounts (expected).

raj-security: good — no signs of data decrypt/exfil. Likely an automation misconfiguration: infra-automation@partner used a system-token that had broader scope than intended. Post-incident actions: - require scoped tokens for partner automations - add approval workflow for tenant-level role grants - add alert rule: high-severity on any tenant-admin binding created outside a whitelisted automation list - review partner token issuance audit and rotate partner token.

sara-support: I've opened an internal ticket: SR-2026-9873 to track the changes and follow-ups (owner: miguel-infra). Adding logs and audit snapshots.

miguel-infra: root cause confirmed: identity-sync job updated bindings after recent partner config change. We'll push a fix to make the sync read-only by default and gate write path behind approval. ETA for code fix: 48h.

olivia_acme: thanks all — appreciate the quick containment and the audit checks. We'll await the fix and the partner token rotation confirmation. :thumbsup:

raj-security: follow-up in 24h with confirmation of partner token rotation + alert rule deployed. Leaving this thread open until SR-2026-9873 is closed.
